1.title: Judge Lets Case Against Tyler Robinson, Charlie Kirk Shooting Suspect, Go to Trial
1.summary: The judge also allowed prosecutors to seek the death penalty against the man, who is accused of assassinating the conservative activist last year.

2.title: Charlie Kirk murder suspect pleads not guilty as judge clears way for death penalty trial
2.summary: Tyler Robinson is charged with aggravated murder, a capital offence in Utah, and six other counts.

3.title: Senator Ed Markey, 80, Turns Back Younger Challenger in Massachusetts
3.summary: The oldest senator in Massachusetts history used a progressive message to beat Representative Seth Moulton, 47, defying calls for generational change.

4.title: Iran retaliates after US strikes kills four at wedding party, state media reports
4.summary: Iranian news agencies said retaliatory missile and drone attacks on US targets had begun.

5.title: China or the U.S.? Two Meetings Offer Competing Showcases of Global Power.
5.summary: As Xi Jinping gathered with the leaders of Russia and Iran, Europe challenged the Trump administration at the G20, offering a split-screen view of a changing world.

6.title: Weeks After Failed Drone Attack, Germany Points Finger at Russia
6.summary: The country said Moscow was behind an explosive-laden drone found near a Ukrainian plane at a German airport last month. President Vladimir Putin of Russia called the accusation “a grave mistake.”
